mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in a single month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods with sustained RSAFS increases, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals increased economic activity and supply-side efficiency, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a single month, it signals inflationary pressure during a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a single month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a single month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between HOUST decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) decreases by more than 0.5% in a quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) also decreases by more than 1% in the same period, it signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% and INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the interaction effect between GDPC1 and INDPRO on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
